IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT BOMBAY

versus
The State of Maharashtra …Respondent
----
Ms  Sindhutai  Mane,  a/w.  Ms  Shabnam  Shaikh,  for  the
applicants.
Mr Swapnil S Pednekar, APP , for the respondent/State.
----
Coram: R.N. Laddha, J.

P.C.:
. After hearing the matter for some time, when this Court
was not inclined to grant the relief, the learned Counse l for the
applicants,  on  instructions,  seeks  leave  to  withdraw  this
application.  Leave granted as prayed for.
2. The application stands dismissed as withdrawn.
(R.N. Laddha, J.)
